title: Communication and Relationship Management
overview: Exceptional communication and relationship management skills are essential for the success of any organization. These core competencies are the foundation of thriving and resilient companies. This course takes a hands-on approach to mastering both aspects, focusing on how to build long-lasting, influential networks. Participants will learn how to effectively organize, analyze, and communicate their thoughts, as well as how to cultivate purposeful and impactful relationships. The course offers practical opportunities to develop and practice these skills, preparing participants to apply them confidently in their workplaces
audience: This course is designed for leaders, managers, supervisors, and anyone looking to enhance their networking and influencing abilities. It is particularly beneficial for those who prioritize collaboration and recognize the significant advantages of building strong, trust-based relationships
methodology: The course emphasizes active participation through business scenarios and case studies, allowing participants to acquire crucial knowledge and skills in communication and relationship management.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand the pivotal role of trust in fostering successful relationships
Identify, analyze, and engage stakeholders using the power/interest matrix
Appreciate the impact of context when communicating and forming relationships
Identify and leverage relationship opportunities that add value and drive results
Develop, manage, and nurture relationships, transitioning from transactional to transformational interactions
Expand and strengthen their network of influence and success
